overall: The AG found the Wayland School Committee violated the OML by not properly responding to two minutes requests and by not timely reviewing and releasing requested executive session minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to timely review executive session minutes in response to requests for them.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to properly respond to the Complainant’s requests for meeting minutes and by failing to review all requested executive session minutes, and release those that were appropriate for release, by the next meeting following the request.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to timely respond to requests for open session and executive session minutes within 10 days.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Review and release, if appropriate, any requested minutes not yet reviewed or released within 30 days of the determination, and certify to the AG's office that it has done so.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
